attributes.additional_details: The entire country is on its knees and if we continue under Labour government they have brought this country to its knees, please sign the petition take back your RIGHTS!!
attributes.background: The country has had 7 prime ministers in the last 10 years that the public didn’t vote for, we can NOT allow another prime minister to be back doored in it must got to the public it’s our constitutional right!

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
